Title: Candidates can download the exam paper before the test is published or opened
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Map a candidate to a draft test that starts in 2030 2) Candidate logs in at the centre 3) GET /api/v1/candidates/tests/{testId}/questions
Actual Result: 200 with every question and option of the paper
Suggested Fix: In assertAssigned also require isPublished=true, isDraft=false and now within startDate/startTime - startBufferTime and endDate/endTime

Title: Every new company admin gets the same default password from .env
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Super admin creates a company from the UI (no adminPassword field) 2) Log in to the new workspace with DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Expected Result: Login refused; owner sets a personal password through an invite link
Actual Result: Login works for every company created this way
Suggested Fix: Remove the shared default; create the account with no usable password and email a one-time set-password link (SES is already wired); force change on first login

Title: Super admin can deactivate or delete their own account and lock out the platform
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Log in as the only super admin 2) PUT /api/v1/admins/{ownId} {isActive:false} or DELETE /api/v1/admins/{ownId}
Expected Result: 400/403 cannot remove the last super admin
Actual Result: 200; the platform has no super admin left until someone edits the DB
Suggested Fix: Block update/delete of role=super_admin rows through /admins (or at least of the caller and of the last active super admin)

Title: Resetting a password does not end the user's existing sessions
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Admin is logged in 2) Super admin sets a new password via PUT /admins/{id} 3) Old access and refresh tokens are used
Actual Result: Old access token and refresh token keep working (same for candidates)
Suggested Fix: When password or isActive changes, increment tokenVersion and clear refreshTokenHash (reuse invalidateSession)

Title: Anyone can lock a real user out for 15 minutes with 5 wrong passwords
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Attacker sends 5 wrong passwords for victim@company 2) Victim logs in with the correct password
Expected Result: Victim can still log in (lock by IP+account or CAPTCHA)
Actual Result: 429 Too many failed login attempts for the real user
Suggested Fix: Key failures by account + client IP, add exponential delay or CAPTCHA instead of a hard lock, alert the account owner

Title: Boolean "false" sent as text is saved as true
Expected Result: 400 isActive must be a boolean (or false)
Actual Result: 200 and isActive=true is saved
Suggested Fix: Turn off enableImplicitConversion for bodies (keep @Type for query DTOs) or add a strict boolean transform

Title: Changing test, candidate or group of a mapping returns 200 but changes nothing
Expected Result: Mapping points to the new test
Actual Result: 200 returned, testId is still the old test
Suggested Fix: Load the mapping without relations before merge, or set the relation objects (test/candidate/group) instead of only the id columns

Title: Exam-day login checks the UTC date, so candidates mapped for today are refused from 00:00 to 05:30 IST
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Map candidate to centre for the Indian date (e.g. 11 Oct) 2) Candidate logs in at 01:00 IST (still 10 Oct in UTC)
Expected Result: Login allowed on the exam date at the centre
Actual Result: 403 You are not mapped to this centre for this date
Suggested Fix: Use the centre/company time zone (store it on company or centre) when computing today's exam date

Title: A new test is published by default when isPublished is not sent
Actual Result: isDraft=true AND isPublished=true; a draft+published combination is also accepted
Suggested Fix: Default is_published to false; reject isDraft=true with isPublished=true

Title: Data that is in use can be deleted (template, language, category, instruction, group, zone, centre, test)
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Create a test that uses category X 2) DELETE /api/v1/categories/X
Actual Result: 200; tests keep pointing to a deleted row and show empty names
Suggested Fix: Before soft delete, check for active children and return 409 with the count, or cascade the soft delete on purpose

Title: CORS blocks the X-Workspace-Id / X-Workspace-Slug headers the frontend always sends
Actual Result: allow-headers=content-type,authorization; every API call fails when UI and API are on different origins
Suggested Fix: Either add the two headers to allowedHeaders or stop sending them from the UI (backend ignores them)

Title: npm ci fails: lockfile points 6 packages to registry.npmmirror.com
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Fresh clone 2) cd admin_backend 3) npm ci
Actual Result: E403 on swagger-ui-dist from registry.npmmirror.com
Suggested Fix: Regenerate lockfile against registry.npmjs.org; add .npmrc with the registry

Title: No migrations; schema only created by synchronize when NODE_ENV is not production
Actual Result: Folder missing; production start with synchronize=false will have no tables; any non-production env auto-alters schema
Suggested Fix: Generate an initial migration, run migrations on deploy, set synchronize=false everywhere

Title: npm audit: 2 critical and 5 high vulnerabilities
Actual Result: handlebars (critical), proxy-addr (critical), multer, fast-uri, js-yaml, brace-expansion (high)
Suggested Fix: Upgrade @nestjs/* to 11.2.7+ and run npm audit fix

Title: Deploy job runs git reset --hard and npm install on the server after copying dist
Expected Result: Deploy the built, tested artifact only
Actual Result: Server pulls develop and installs packages itself (dist and source can differ); NODE_ENV not set, so synchronize may run on the real DB
Suggested Fix: Deploy the Docker image built in CI; set NODE_ENV=production; run migrations as a step

Title: Login lockout ignores the company, so one tenant's failures lock other tenants
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Same email is admin in company A and B (or same enrollment number in A and B) 2) 5 wrong passwords in A 3) Log in to B
Actual Result: 429 in company B too
Suggested Fix: Include companyId (from the company token) in the lockout key

Title: Large numbers and impossible dates crash with 500
Steps to Reproduce: 1) POST /api/v1/tests totalMarks=1000000000 (or startDate=2030-02-30, or totalQuestions=3e9) 2) PATCH mapping result=1000
Actual Result: 500 Something went wrong
Related Test ID: BE-ERR-003; BE-ERR-004; BE-TC-1163; BE-ERR-005; BE-ERR-006; BE-ERR-007
Suggested Fix: Add @Max to every numeric field to match the column type; map Postgres 22003 and 22008 to 400 in QueryFailedFilter; use IsDateString({strict:true}) for date-only fields

Title: Creating companies or sessions at the same time fails with 409
Actual Result: Only 1-2 succeed; others get 409 'company code is already in use'
Suggested Fix: Use a Postgres sequence per prefix (or retry on 23505), not MAX()+1

Title: Total questions can be lowered below the questions already added
Actual Result: 200; test now has more questions than allowed
Suggested Fix: On update, count questions (non-comprehension) and reject totalQuestions below that count

Title: A test can be published with no questions and no schedule
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Create test without dates and questions 2) PATCH isPublished=true
Actual Result: 200 published
Suggested Fix: Validate publish readiness: question count = totalQuestions, marks match, dates set, settings exist

Title: Multi-day test is rejected when its end time is earlier than its start time
Actual Result: 400 End time must be after start time
Suggested Fix: Compare full start and end date-time, not the time of day only

Title: Optional extra time cannot be left empty: handicappedDurationMinutes is required and 0 is rejected
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Admin leaves 'For Handicapped' empty in the UI (sends 0) 2) POST /tests
Actual Result: 400 Handicapped duration must be >= normal duration
Suggested Fix: Make handicappedDurationMinutes optional (default = durationMinutes) and agree the rule with the UI

Title: Scoring values are not checked (negative right marks, negative marks bigger than right marks)
Suggested Fix: @Min(0) on rightMarks/negativeMarks; negativeMarks <= rightMarks; range checks for rangeFrom/rangeTo

Title: Candidate detail keeps showing old documents for 3 hours (stale cache)
Actual Result: Old cached response without the document
Suggested Fix: Also delete candidatesCache.itemKey(companyId, candidateId) when documents change

Title: Instruction HTML is stored with <script> tags (stored XSS risk in the exam app)
Actual Result: Saved and returned unchanged to candidates
Suggested Fix: Sanitise rich text on save with an allow-list (e.g. sanitize-html) for instructions, question text, options, messages

Title: Document file URL accepts javascript: and any text
Suggested Fix: Accept only storage keys under the tenant prefix or https URLs (IsUrl({protocols:['https']}))

Title: Company fields are not validated (colour, workspace URL, phone, plan end date)
Steps to Reproduce: 1) POST /super-admin/companies with primaryColor='not-a-color', workspaceUrl='javascript:alert(1)', phone='call me', planEndsAt in 2000
Actual Result: 201 for each
Suggested Fix: IsHexColor, phone pattern, workspace slug pattern (^[a-z0-9-]{3,50}$) and store slug only, planEndsAt in the future

Title: Weak passwords are accepted for admins and candidates
Expected Result: 400 (same rule as the UI: upper, lower, number, symbol)
Suggested Fix: Share one password rule (min 8, upper, lower, number, symbol) in a custom validator

Title: Mapping results and membership are not validated
Steps to Reproduce: 1) PATCH mapping percentage=150, correct+wrong > attempted, completedAt < startedAt 2) Create mapping with a group the candidate is not in 3) Assign group with inactive candidates
Actual Result: All accepted
Suggested Fix: Add range and cross-field checks; check group membership; filter isActive in findByGroupIds

Title: Candidate can be mapped to two centres on the same day and to past dates
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Map candidate to centre A today 2) Map to centre B today 3) Map to 2001-01-01
Actual Result: 201 for both
Suggested Fix: Unique (company, candidate, examDate); examDate >= today

Title: Swagger API docs are public in every environment
Expected Result: Hidden in production or behind auth
Actual Result: 200 full API documentation
Suggested Fix: Only call SwaggerModule.setup when NODE_ENV !== 'production', or protect with basic auth

Title: Login throttle uses the proxy IP and refresh has no throttle
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Run behind a load balancer 2) 10 logins from user A 3) New user B logs in 4) Call /auth/refresh 30 times
Actual Result: User B blocked (shared proxy IP); refresh never throttled
Suggested Fix: app.set('trust proxy', <hops>) and use req.ip; apply @LoginRateLimit to refresh endpoints

Title: Uploaded file content is not checked (renamed .exe and empty files pass)
Steps to Reproduce: 1) POST /files/upload a file with MZ bytes named photo.jpg type image/jpeg 2) Upload a 0-byte file
Actual Result: Passes all checks (stops only at S3 because S3 is off in QA)
Suggested Fix: Check magic bytes (file-type package), reject size 0, re-encode images

Title: Only one refresh token per user: logging in on a second device logs out the first
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Log in on laptop 2) Log in on phone 3) Laptop refreshes
Actual Result: 401 Invalid refresh token on laptop
Suggested Fix: Store refresh tokens in a sessions table (one row per device, keyed by jti)

Title: Centre user role has no endpoints except login/me/logout
Expected Result: Can see candidates of own centre
Actual Result: 401 (admin-only); role cannot do any centre work
Suggested Fix: Assumption: centre staff should check in candidates. Add @CentreAuth endpoints scoped by request.centreId, or document the role as future work

Title: No protection against two admins overwriting each other
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Admin 1 opens group 2) Admin 2 renames 3) Admin 1 saves old form
Actual Result: 200; admin 2's rename is lost
Suggested Fix: Send updatedAt/version with updates and reject stale writes (TypeORM @VersionColumn)

Title: No API to submit answers or calculate results
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Candidate opens paper 2) Look for an answer/submit endpoint
Expected Result: Candidate can submit answers; results stored
Actual Result: No such endpoint; result fields are only editable by admins
Suggested Fix: Assumption: exam delivery may be another service. If not, add attempt start/save/submit endpoints and server-side scoring

Title: No .env.example and README is the NestJS template
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Read admin_backend/README.md 2) Look for env docs
Expected Result: List of 40 env variables and run steps
Actual Result: Boilerplate README; env names only found by reading code
Suggested Fix: Add .env.example (see .env.example.qa) and a real README with setup, seed and test commands

Title: Project has no tests and CI ignores lint errors
Actual Result: 'No tests found'; lint step ends with '|| true'; README mentions test:e2e which does not exist
Suggested Fix: Add unit/e2e tests (qa_tests can be a start), remove '|| true'

Title: Test rules missing: grace marks above total and dates in the past are accepted
Steps to Reproduce: 1) POST /tests graceMarks=500 totalMarks=40 2) POST /tests with 2001 dates
Suggested Fix: graceMarks <= totalMarks; startDate >= today on create

Title: Question topic is not checked against the subject/category mapping
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Create a topic with no CST mapping 2) POST /questions with that topic
Suggested Fix: Check that (test.categoryId, subjectId, topicId) exists in category_subject_topic_mappings

Title: Admin first name can be updated to an empty string
Actual Result: 200 empty name saved
Suggested Fix: Add @IsNotEmpty to optional string fields in update DTOs

Title: Candidate mobile and date of birth are not validated
Suggested Fix: Phone pattern; dateOfBirth must be in the past

Title: Names are unique only with exact letter case
Actual Result: 201 duplicate (also centre codes)
Related Test ID: BE-EC-017; BE-EC-021; BE-EC-025; BE-EC-029; BE-EC-033; BE-EC-037; BE-EC-041; BE-EC-079
Suggested Fix: Unique index on lower(name) (or citext); normalise codes to upper case

Title: Too-long text gets a generic message without the field name
Actual Result: 400 'This value is too long'
Suggested Fix: Add @MaxLength matching each varchar column

Title: Test messages have no length limit
Suggested Fix: @MaxLength(2000) on pass/fail/submission messages

Title: Feedback can be sent before the test has happened
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Candidate mapped to a 2030 draft test 2) POST /candidates/tests/{id}/feedback
Suggested Fix: Allow feedback only when the mapping status is completed

Title: Capacity and date rules missing for labs, events and sessions
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Lab seats 5000 in a 30-seat centre 2) Event instructionAt after closing 3) One-day session
File Path (if known): labs.service.ts; events.service.ts; sessions.service.ts (assertValidDateRange uses end <= start)
Suggested Fix: Check seats against centre; instructionAt inside window; allow endDate == startDate for sessions

Title: Public health endpoint reveals infrastructure details
Actual Result: Lists database and redis status
Suggested Fix: Return a plain status publicly; keep details behind auth or internal network

Title: Login error for an inactive account confirms the password was right
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Deactivate admin 2) Log in with right password, then with wrong password
Actual Result: 'This account is inactive' only when the password is right
Suggested Fix: Check isActive together with the password and return the generic message

Title: Super admin calling a company endpoint gets 'Please sign in again'
Actual Result: 401 Please sign in again (front end then logs out)
Suggested Fix: Add @Roles(AdminRole.ADMIN) to tenant controllers so RolesGuard returns 403

Title: Small auth inconsistencies: lower-case 'bearer' rejected, refresh returns 201
Actual Result: 401 / 201 (candidate and centre refresh return 200)
Suggested Fix: Compare scheme case-insensitively; add @HttpCode(200) to /auth/refresh

Title: Status toggle from the UI wipes address line 2 (API saves empty string)
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Company has addressLine2 2) PUT with addressLine2:'' and status
Expected Result: Optional empty strings ignored or UI sends only status
Actual Result: addressLine2 erased
Suggested Fix: Treat '' as 'no change' for optional fields or require PATCH semantics; main fix is in the UI (FE bug)

Title: Deleting a company leaves its admins active
Actual Result: Admins still active (they cannot log in only because company lookup fails)
Suggested Fix: Soft delete company admins and revoke their tokens in the same transaction

Title: Workspace verify endpoint has no rate limit (workspace enumeration)
Actual Result: All answered
Suggested Fix: Apply a throttler to verify-workspace

Title: Numbers are silently converted to text
Actual Result: 201 with name '12345'
Suggested Fix: Same as boolean fix: disable implicit conversion for bodies

Title: Filter by test code needs the exact full code
Actual Result: 0 items
Suggested Fix: Use ilikePrefix for testCode

Title: db:create script points to a missing tsconfig.scripts.json
Actual Result: ts-node cannot find tsconfig.scripts.json
Suggested Fix: Add the tsconfig or use tsconfig.json

Title: ESLint reports 116 errors and tsc --noEmit fails
Actual Result: 116 errors (60 prettier, 49 unsafe any); TS4053 in candidate-exam.controller.ts
Suggested Fix: Run eslint --fix; export ExamQuestion types; add return types
